profiles.name: Intercom
profiles.why: Intercom's own pricing page prices its combined helpdesk and Fin AI Agent at $19 per seat/mo plus $0.99 per outcome, matching the discovery hypothesis of a full, per-seat-priced AI-first support platform with omnichannel inbox, ticketing and Knowledge Hub. Crisp customer Reedsy says it evaluated Intercom and Zendesk and switched to Crisp for its 'robust, affordable feature set,' while still getting an omnichannel inbox and its own AI Hub for training automation; this documents one customer's stated price/feature preference, not an absence of those capabilities at Intercom.

profiles.one_liner: A complete system for AI and human customer service
profiles.promise: Intercom is the only helpdesk with a natively integrated AI Agent, Fin, meaning every customer conversation improves the next one, enabling perfect experiences that were never possible before.
